ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels localized at the boundaries and in focal spots, creating a high-contrast macro-distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central zone. Black perimeter banding concentrated on the leading and trailing edges. Specific low-intensity focal spots detected: one circular 2D blob on the mid-left lobe and a series of dark linear streaks on the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with variable pixel-depth (approx. 5-15 pixels) extending across the continuous trailing edge. Notable jaggedness is present on the proximal section of the left lobe and the distal tip of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-convex hybrid sweep terminating in sharp, retroflexed (hooked) distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, circular high-intensity pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) are localized on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, dark, unaligned diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two prominent circular dark pigmentation marks on the left lobe; significant structural irregularity and heavy biological encrustation on the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced 'hook' shape of the distal tips with high-relief texture that breaks the 2D plane of the fluke edge.
